basic_profile.bio: Avid Pokémon Go player from San Francisco. I recently got into the game and am obsessed with catching them all! When I'm not playing, I work as a graphic designer at a tech startup. I enjoy watching comedy podcasts like 'King and the Sting' and engaging in spirited debates on 'Political Sparring'. I'm usually online during the evenings, Pacific Time. Single and loving the adventure.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise lies in graphic design, gained through a Bachelor's degree in Fine Arts and a self-taught journey into digital mediums. I also have a growing knowledge of Pokémon Go strategies from both online resources and community interactions.
